what: The large framed photo changes to the next one every 3.65s — the next one is laid on top and opens from bottom to top in 1.35s power2.inOut, and the photo inside it settles into place from 1.14x with a 1.8% bottom offset over 5s (opening + interval) power1.out. The small frame (inset) beside it always gets the one after that, opening from the bottom in the same 1.35s and relaxing from 1.12x — two cuts of the same house overlapping as they turn, a frame within a frame. Pauses when off-screen

options.every: Interval to the next slide (s), default 3.65
options.dur: Time for the next chapter to open (s), default 1.35
options.zoom: Starting scale of the big frame’s new section, default 1.14 (1.1 at width 768 and below)
options.ease: Opening curve — a GSAP name or ”0.65,0,0.35,1”, default power2.inOut
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: One slide of a large frame (two or more) — its first child is the photo whose zoom releases
options.[data-fx-part=inset]: (if present) a small frame showing the next section — the part copies the section’s photo into it. Size and position are the consuming side’s css

note: The original Hero has a loader before this where a small window grows to fill the screen (site index.js) — the part skips the loader and runs only the slide transition in the full state

from.where: index.html .hero (frame-in-frame hero) — original HomeHeroController: heroSlideInterval 3.65, heroSlideRevealDuration 1.35 power2.inOut, new slide photo scale 1.14·yPercent 1.8 (phone 1.1·1)→1·0 power1.out, inset next slide clip inset(100% 0 0 0)→0 + scale 1.12→1, pauses when off-screen (threshold .05)
